testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.wiring.ManagementTransportTests

testcase.name: retryable is true only for a throttled or timed out call()
the raw mutation route does not exist - 404 for a signed in administrator, not 403 or 405()
the limit is enforced on the bytes actually sent, not on the declared length()
a valid body is accepted and an oversized one is a 413 with the envelope, no data change and nothing in the log(CapturedOutput)
Spring mounts exactly the approved Management routes and nothing else()
access, validation and framework errors all use the frozen envelope()
every approved route reaches a controller - a signed in administrator never gets a framework 404 or 405 on them()
